recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大量偏心核的漿細胞與淡染組織球混合浸潤，並散在一顆嗜酸性球，左上方有粉紅色膠原與梭形細胞構成的纖維化區，呈現漿細胞增生合併硬化的反應性淋巴結炎。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate with numerous plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs
Admixed histiocytes with vesicular oval nuclei and pale, focally vacuolated cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes and an occasional eosinophil with bright red granules
Collagenous sclerosis with streaming spindle cells at the upper left
Focal endothelial-lined spaces; no sheets of large atypical cells
describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows a polymorphous inflammatory infiltrate composed of numerous plasma cells, histiocytes with vesicular nuclei, small lymphocytes, and an occasional eosinophil. A zone of collagenous sclerosis with streaming spindle cells is present at the upper left of the field. There are no sheets of atypical large cells or Reed-Sternberg-like cells, and no necrosis is identified. Findings are consistent with reactive lymphadenitis with plasmacytosis and sclerosis, suggestive of syphilitic lymphadenitis in the proper clinical setting; Treponema immunostain and serology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Mixed cellularity CHL also has plasma cells and eosinophils, but contains diagnostic CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are not seen here.
Castleman disease shows interfollicular plasma cell sheets with abnormal follicles and prominent vascularity, without spirochetes on immunostaining.
IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4+ plasma cells with a raised IgG4/IgG ratio and storiform fibrosis, with negative Treponema staining.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with reactive background
ddx.vs: PTCL shows cytologically atypical medium-to-large T cells with aberrant immunophenotype and clonal TCR rearrangement, beyond the bland cytology present here.
